name: Sandy Soil
description: Light, warm, dry and tend to be acidic and low in nutrients.

name: Loamy Soil
description: A balanced mixture of sand, silt, and clay. Highly fertile and suitable for most crops.

name: Clay Soil
description: Heavy soils that hold high amounts of water and nutrients but have poor drainage.

name: Black Soil (Regur)
description: Clayey, deep, and impermeable. High moisture retention capacity.

name: Red Soil
description: Porous, friable, and less fertile, usually requiring fertilizers.
